title: BA-Thesis
summary: A bachelor's-thesis benchmark comparing several tabular synthetic-data generators (CTGAN, CTAB-GAN-Plus, TabSyn, TabDiff) for outlier preservation on medical datasets such as arrhythmia, breast cancer, heart disease and thyroid. SDV's CTGANSynthesizer is directly instantiated and trained on each dataset via sdv.single_table and sdv.metadata as one of the compared generators.
needs: sdmetrics/rdt imports appear only inside models/tabsyn-main (a cloned third-party TabSyn repo per README), so it's unclear whether those calls were actively invoked by this thesis's own pipeline or merely inherited from the vendored project.
